name: veterinary_clinic_system_032_cs_running_balance_reconciliation
instruction: DEA-style reconciliation: for each controlled item, the expected on-hand balance is sum(receive) - sum(administer) - sum(waste) - sum(dispense) over controlled_substance_log. Compare with pharmacy_inventory.quantity_on_hand for is_controlled items (sum across locations). Create one ops_reports row per controlled item present in the LOG: {report: 'cs_reconciliation', batch_code, item_name, log_balance: <number>, inventory_on_hand: <number or null if no inventory row>, discrepancy: <log_balance - inventory_on_hand, or null>}. Any order. Exactly one row per distinct logged item.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute per-item balances from live cs log; inventory sums from live pharmacy_inventory where is_controlled. Assert one row per distinct logged item_name, exact numeric equality (floats within 1e-9), nulls where no inventory match; nonce correct.

checks.expect: Recompute per-item balances from live cs log; inventory sums from live pharmacy_inventory where is_controlled. Assert one row per distinct logged item_name, exact numeric equality (floats within 1e-9)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Sign-correct multi-action ledger aggregation (receive positive, others negative) and intentional null handling; agents flip dispense/waste signs.
